about: Materials of well-known buildings for the code art (method A, v2/layers/art_a.py), where the seeded rule would give a famous building a colour it does not have. One entry per ACT building id: facade (a palette buildings.facade_* name) or stone (true: yellow sandstone ashlar), and roof (a palette buildings.roof_* name). Everything else about the building (windows, surrounds, tone) follows the rule. Chosen by hand from public photographs; add a building here rather than changing the rule.
